dialogues.speaker: Przybor
dialogues.text: Really? Are you sure? You look like you know a thing or two, so I guess I'll take your word for it.

dialogues.speaker: Przybor
dialogues.text: Someone like you, I bet you have an interesting job. Not like me, all I'm cut out for is a life on the seas. But I don't want to waste my whole life away sailing the oceans.

dialogues.speaker: Przybor
dialogues.text: The upside is, merchant ships like ours get to see a lot of places. I'm sure to find an interesting job one day as well!
